title: Some counterexamples concerning a model of eradication of invasive species
summary: In this note we study the regularity properties of the \emph{Effort Function $E(β)$}. This can be defined as the minimal $L^1$-norm of the control $\tilde α(x) \geq 0$ so that the PDE $$U_t = ΔU + f(U) - \tilde α(t,x) U, \quad U \in [0,1], %\ \tilde α\geq 0,$$ admits a traveling profile $U(x - βt)$ connecting $0$ to $1$. The above PDE models the evolution of an invasive species, where the control $\tilde α(t,x)$ describes the percentage amount of species removal.
